title: Making corrections difficult
text: The report is only as good as the input. Misspelling and wrong words are difficult to edit from the transcript. Named speakers will be mis identified. While you can change the speaker name. It is set to do it globally for that speaker as a default. That results in disaster. If two people have been misidentified to the same name. There is no way to split a passage  in the transcript attributed to one person when it was actually 2 people talking one after another. I’m using this to take notes to create minutes in the Robert’s rules format. Exporting audio data is difficult. Sometimes it saves as mp4 file sometimes as an mpeg-4 movie file. Super annoying.
